# U21: Type the week’s numbers in one table, and change several goals at once

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `BULK-EDIT`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Chen, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 2310

## Steps and checks

- **Step.** Press the “all your numbers in one table” link.
- _Note:_ Chen has two goals to post (Jenkins jobs, integration tests), both numbers.
- A value `ratio` of the way the plan expected by the week (`valueAt`).
- A value `ratio` of the way the plan expected by the week (`valueAt`).
